notes.title: ¡¡¡¡DECA RELEASE!!!!
notes.notes:
Hellow every body we are so happy to present you the final version of DECA!

To thank you for your support during development, we have given access one day before launch to people who purchased early access.

If you have any problem updating the game, uninstall the previous version and reinstall the new one.

We hope you enjoy the game a lot and that it scares you!
